title: Quest Foglight for Databases writeTopologySectionToFile External Control of File Path Remote Code… (CVE-2026-92189)
description: CVE-2026-92189 is a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases. It arises from improper validation of user-supplied file paths in the writeTopologySectionToFile method, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.
